description:
When our kids are really little, they need to know they matter. Of course they need structure, routines and all of the other stuff, but what they really need in order for their sense of self to form is to know that they matter - their needs matter, they are loved regardless of what they do, and that they are deeply loved by the people closest to them.

Video @project.fatherhood
